content.text:
Create one 16:9 widescreen cinematic concept keyframe, requested 2048x1152, for a quiet maritime-industrial game in the coastal watchroom of Eunpo harbor. This is new film and gameplay-experience visual development grounded ONLY in the two attached original preproduction concept images, not in any existing game screenshot, runtime asset or prefab. Input 1 is the original tool-reader-hero and is the instrument shape authority. Input 2 is the original space-hub-watchroom-mood and is the room, materials and scale authority.

A close cinematic gameplay vantage looks slightly down over the original physical salt-optical instrument, integrated naturally into that original expansive watchroom. Preserve the thick circular rotating base and its shallow circular cradle holding a visibly HEXAGONAL SALT-CRYSTAL PLATE with fine crystalline structure and salt edge growth, not a blank flat disc. Keep the right rear brass pillar, articulated optical arm, large real glass magnifier, vertical fine probe and fine-adjustment controls, and side crank with an ochre handle. Dominant silhouette is circle plus optical arm. Leave the right lower crank/handle clearly readable and reachable from the camera side for later deliberate hand action, but show NO hands or person in this still. No rectangular paper bed and no paired parallel guide rails.

The instrument stands on the worn wet PERFORATED METAL workbench of the original room. Nearby layered paper records and simple physical holders match the original concept and remain secondary, with no legible writing. Beyond the bench, retain the original generous windows, dark sea between breakwaters, worn rows of drawers, restrained analog instrument silhouettes and salt-encrusted pipe couplings. Convey quiet pressure, heavy procedure and real physical materials. Subdued deep-ink and sea-teal diffuse coastal fill contrasts with one restrained warm brass worklamp. Painterly semi-realistic cinematic image with clear tactile detail and natural optical depth; restrained physically credible highlights, no glossy CGI.

Use the original formal palette: deep ink #0E1F26, seal ink #173238, wet-metal blue-grey #36565C, verdigris bronze #4F7A6B, wet concrete #8A8E88, salt-crystal pale cyan #C8D6D3, records-paper off-white #E7E3D8, a single ochre accent #E2AF62 below eight percent of frame. Bronze has dark substrate and downward corrosion streaks. Fine hexagonal salt growth comes from edges, not snow or sugar lumps. Everything is used and weathered. Do not make the optical plate emissive.

NEGATIVE: no modern UI, floating labels, captions, text, legible words or numbers, watermark, logos, computer screens, holograms, magic glow, supernatural effects, neon, lens flare, bloom, rectangular paper bed, paired guide rails, existing game capture, existing prefab styling, clean chrome, polished futuristic machine, weapon, combat, blood, ghost, hand, person, blank flat plate. Deliver one clean original image with no diagram borders, montage or split panels.
